title: The panel's own code notes still say Member messages, trainer pages and the join free trial are not live, though they are
what: The notes at the top of the rules for Member messages, for choosing who reads a member's message, for trainer pages and bookings, and for the free trial on the join page all say their database part is not live yet. The live database has every one of those parts, and the panel uses them today. Whoever works on these next, without the owner to ask, may think the features are off, hold back a fix, or plan a switch-on that already happened.
expected: Each note says the true state: live since its date, or not live.
how_often: every time someone reads these notes
fix_line: Change the four notes to say these parts are live, with the day they went live
